links.fact: The Strategic Bitcoin Reserve executive order signed March 6, 2025 capitalizes the reserve with bitcoin the government already holds, bars sales, and authorizes no taxpayer-funded purchases; estimated federal holdings of about 328,372 BTC as of February 2026 are a tracker-based estimate, which coinpedia contests.
